coverage_limits: No live fetch, no code execution and no writes inside inputs/ occurred in this session; every proposed validation remains UNEXECUTED.

Reader-implementation evidence is absent from the corpus by construction (S003 L813-L814 is a bare pointer); all interoperability statements rest on conformance text alone and are labeled accordingly.

Corpus completeness beyond the six read paths and ten probed paths is not assertable: no directory enumeration was available, and both mechanical line_map attempts returned tool-boundary errors without data.
Seed block hashes were taken verbatim from the admitted hashes file; no independent hash recomputation was possible in the bounded toolset.
One seed read was output-truncated by the reader (call 1, inside line 55); coverage was completed with a second read of lines 54-58, so no seed content was judged from a truncated portion alone.

Version-history one-liners (S003 L822-L866) were used only as historical context, never as normative overrides; where one conflicts with a normative section (dimension_names, L827 vs L174) the normative section governs and the conflict is recorded.
